title: Largest Rectangular Banner
statement: A row of n adjacent poles of width 1 has the given heights. Find the area of the largest rectangle that fits entirely within the poles, aligned with the ground.
input_format: The first line contains n. The second line contains n heights.

examples.explanation: Heights 5 and 6 side by side give a 2 by 5 rectangle of area 10.

hints: For each pole, the best rectangle using its full height stretches until a shorter pole on each side.
A stack of increasing heights finds those boundaries in one pass.
Areas can exceed 32 bits; use 64-bit arithmetic.
